claim_a: Safe Path ~50–200ms appears in one source budget/table.
claim_b: Another source passage allows Safe Path ~50–500ms while a critical total target under 100ms also appears.
resolution: UNRESOLVED: exact physical/domain latency budget must be defined by target hardware/domain profiling and a future authoritative performance contract.
do_not_do: Do not select one numeric range as canonical production truth without a newer locked source/evidence.

claim_b: Game-authoritative numeric law uses deterministic saturating/clamped arithmetic in its game domain.
resolution: Not a conflict: separate authority domains. Core law governs constitutional Core; game numeric law governs authoritative game simulation.
do_not_do: Do not merge the arithmetic policies into one global rule.

claim_a: L1o/Lo3 may retain Top-K/multiple internal candidates.
claim_b: Final NEXY release is one output or freeze/silence.
resolution: Not a conflict: multiple candidates are internal reasoning state; release boundary collapses/adjudicates to one legal final output.
do_not_do: Do not expose internal candidates as multiple authoritative finals.

claim_a: Older compressed canon describes AI runtime memory as none/no uncontrolled long-term memory.
claim_b: Later L1o/Lo2 define explicit working/verified/experimental/quanta/law memories.
resolution: Later design distinguishes uncontrolled conversational/model memory from explicit governed system memory. Treat as scope/evolution distinction.
do_not_do: Do not infer that all governed system memory is forbidden.

claim_a: Vault is persistent project source of truth.
claim_b: CORE/LAW/JUDGE remain authority for truth/release; storage itself is not decision authority.
resolution: Vault is authoritative persistence/lineage for project artifacts; it does not independently adjudicate semantic truth.
do_not_do: Do not promote storage existence into decision authority.

claim_b: Current DOC-C explicitly excludes or does not include several of these.
resolution: Not a semantic conflict. Future/source-design objects do not become current DOC-C build obligations unless promoted by spec extension.
do_not_do: Do not audit current DOC-C as FAIL merely because future architecture is not implemented.

claim_a: Older language implies Owner/Architect can override everything/ad-hoc.
claim_b: Later Human & Operational Determinism forbids generic force and requires predefined signed/auditable procedures.
resolution: Later operational law governs. Owner authority exists only through allowed procedures.
do_not_do: Do not implement generic force bypass from older prose.

claim_a: Earlier Lo2 vision silently updates L1o/Lo3 kernels.
claim_b: Later version/evolution law requires governed/versioned change and DOC-C excludes self-patch/auto-heal runtime.
resolution: Lo2 may synthesize/propose/package evolution, but authoritative runtime promotion must use legal version/governance/build/deploy path.
do_not_do: Do not implement invisible self-modifying production kernel from old vision.

do_not_do: Do not use CLAIM-TRUTH-ABSOLUTE-OLD as current authority where CLAIM-TRUTH-BOUNDED-NEW applies.

claim_a: L1o bounded-truth design defines CTS tiers T0 Unknown, T1 Heuristic, T2 Empirical, T3 Formally Verified, T4 Immutable Law and says release depends on the domain's allowed tier/threshold.
claim_b: The normalized authoritative source does not establish one numeric CTS threshold that can be safely enforced as a universal constant.
resolution: UNRESOLVED: keep CTS tier semantics explicit and require a newer authoritative domain/release contract before assigning any numeric threshold.
do_not_do: Do not invent, infer, or hard-code a numeric CTS threshold from model judgment, historical prose, or unrelated confidence constants.
